# pvecli ct remove

Delete one or more containers.

```text
pvecli ct remove [CTIDS] [OPTIONS]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `CTIDS` | Container ID(s) - single, comma-separated, or range (e.g., 100, 100,101, 100-105). |

## Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `--purge` | Remove from backup/HA config. |
| `-f`, `--force` | Force stop container before deletion. |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Skip confirmation. |
